info.title: Portal Research Report API
info.description: P18 same-origin immutable Research report and bounded reproducible JSON/CSV export. Report assembly reads only sealed P13--P17 Portal projections; no operation starts QuantBT, reads a worker/artifact path, opens a source data store, or exposes source cursors/credentials. Approval annotation is intentionally outside the frozen core. X2 (additive, 1.2.0): FrozenCoreV2 may carry `final_audit` (P18-T10: reused original vs linked child with source refs) and a failed/cancelled run is sealed as FrozenCoreFailedV1 (spec 09 T06). PARQUET stays unavailable (P18_CONTROL_API_HAS_NO_PINNED_PARQUET_WRITER) and ARCHIVE stays unavailable (P18_ARCHIVE_WOULD_EXPOSE_PRIVATE_P05_BYTES_AND_RAW_MARKET_ROWS).

get.summary: Read the latest sealed immutable report core for a run
get.description: Known native execution runs without a sealed Report return 200 ReportUnavailable (NOT_PUBLISHED / NATIVE_REPORT_NOT_DELIVERED), authorized by the exact immutable execution-profile id and digest. Existing sealed Reports return ReportDetail unchanged. Unknown or foreign runs answer 404 RESEARCH_REPORT_NOT_FOUND. No engine call, seal, repair claim or export is made for native absence. Narrow schema_version before accessing frozen_core. Only export creation/download can answer 409.

200.description: Sealed Report or typed native absence, with a private representation ETag.

304.description: Exact authorized Report/absence representation remains current; authorization precedes revalidation.

post.summary: Create or return one durable bounded export job for the caller
post.description: Requires same-origin CSRF/origin checks. A request persists a JSON/CSV transform job only; it does not rerun an engine or touch a source/artifact filesystem.

get.summary: Read the caller-owned export job status

200.description: Bounded job status; download link exists only at READY.

get.summary: Download one caller-owned completed bounded export

200.description: Authenticated JSON or CSV attachment; max 512 KiB and generated filename only.

ReportEtag.description: Quoted private validator of the authorized Report or typed absence representation. A native absence has p18a1, not a forged sealed-core p18r1 identity. Authorization precedes revalidation.

Problem.description: Typed same-origin refusal. No source relation, cursor, worker/artifact path, source credentials or compute authority is disclosed.

ReportRead.description: Narrow schema_version before reading frozen_core. A missing native Report is a typed 200, not an invented seal. Existing immutable Reports take precedence. Unknown/foreign runs remain 404; permissions and feature refusal remain unchanged.

OptimizerDisclosure.description: Source-retained optimizer evidence. Native objective and selector ranking score are separate. Bootstrap statistics are synthetic proxy, not realized OOS. A centroid has parameters and null trial identity; Mode 4 uses IS only without fabricated inner folds; Mode 5 is full-sample calibration, never untouched OOS.

ProtocolDisclosure.description: Native Three Window facts: calibration uses IS and OOS only; independent holdout runs after frozen selection. UTC half-open windows are contiguous. Runtime verifies every emitted series point stays inside its own window. Observation/analytics rows are calibration OOS, never relabelled untouched holdout. No filesystem locator or engine input is exposed.

EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.title: ResearchAllTimeDistributions
EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.description: Additive precomputed OOS companion, including a partial leading month. Daily histogram is all-time, not a trade or per-bar histogram. Original seals remain immutable.

IdentityQualifier.description: E14 (9.7): what an identity value does not say on its own. A fixed-profile run still carries the optimizer its request declared, so the value reads as if a search had run; this is the same fact Screen 06 publishes as requested_optimizer = DECLARED_NOT_EXECUTED.

FinalAudit.description: X2 · P18-T10 (guide §5.6): the report's final audit. REUSED_ORIGINAL — the run is its own audit; on the retained WFO lane each fold's out-of-sample generation child is checked to be the frozen candidate (QuantBT child audit), so `optimizer_reinvoked` is false only when every fold matched. LINKED_CHILD — a READY AUDIT_OF_SELECTION run in the P19 lineage. NOT_PUBLISHED when the lineage relation was not read.

FrozenCoreFailedV1.description: X2 · spec 09 T06: the sheet of a run that FAILED or was cancelled. No claim: sealed from the P11 terminal snapshot (stages, artifacts — ABORTED stays ABORTED — and the bounded failure), with no metric, equity or fold row. The headline reads `no claim — run failed at {stage}`; the failing stage's check is FAIL with the failure code, earlier stages carry no sealed check, later ones are NOT_APPLICABLE.

FrozenCore.description: A sealed core is served under the schema it was sealed with. v1 cores stay byte-identical; every report sealed after W6a is v2 (P04 fixed profile or the retained Delta WFO lane). X2: a run that FAILED or was cancelled is sealed as FrozenCoreFailedV1 (spec 09 T06).

source_revision_scope.description: Frozen source_revisions are archived response-revision pins at capture time, including then-current presentation. Never compare them unconditionally with a newer live read or rewrite an old seal. Compare immutable source_digests for source identity.

final_audit_applicable.description: Installed linked-audit target compatibility: true for a typed SINGLE_PARAMETER_SET, false for FIXED_PARAMETER_PROFILE or PER_FOLD_PARAMETER_SELECTIONS, null when unpublished. Not feature enablement, RBAC or may_create. The linked audit GET remains the permission authority; do not probe when false/null.

VerifiedPinnedAudit.description: Immutable, worker-fenced receipt whose child and original target/parts were byte-verified. result_digest hashes canonical result; child_run_id=result.run_id. No raw config, params, data, artifact locator or transport secrets.
